source.snippet: I need a tool or service that tells me, for a given library and version, whether it has been deprecated or whether newer releases contain breaking changes, before I upgrade. Requirements: Ecosystems: npm and Maven/Gradle (Android) at least; CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager would be a big plus. Reports deprecations (with dates when available) and breaking changes, not only new versions. Machine-readable access: REST API, RSS/Atom feed or downloadable data. Free or open source preferred; a self-hosted option would be a big plus.

problem_statement: Software development teams have no reliable, machine-readable service to check whether a specific library version has been deprecated or introduces breaking changes before upgrading, across npm, Maven, CocoaPods, and Swift Package Manager ecosystems.
target_segment: Mobile and backend developers at software companies and agencies managing multi-ecosystem dependency upgrades
notes: Buyer is a developer working in a business context (Android + iOS projects), explicitly requested REST API / RSS feed access — implies integration into CI pipelines. Preferred paid or self-hosted, suggesting willingness to pay for a reliable hosted option. Single signal but very specific requirements list; worth validating against other developer communities.
